verdicts.title: Riemann-Roch isometries in the non-compact orbifold setting
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We generalize work of Deligne and Gillet-Soulé on a Riemann-Roch type isometry, to the case of the trivial sheaf on cusp compactifications of Riemann surfaces $Γ\backslash\mathbb{H}$, for $Γ\subset PSL_{2}(\mathbb{R})$ a fuchsian group of the first kind, equipped with the Poincaré metric. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns a Riemann-Roch type isometry for the trivial sheaf on cusp compactifications of Riemann surfaces with the Poincaré metric, generalizing Deligne and Gillet-Soulé. It says nothing about Eichler-Shimura sheaf ranks, 3-CNF formulas, or XOR-AND tree width.
